Shelter and support

What HUP can help with.

HUP provides temporary accommodation, daily meals for clients, counselling, help finding work and referrals. Call the team to ask what is available for your situation.

Accommodation

Temporary shelter

HUP is listed as a men’s homeless shelter. Call to ask about space, who can stay and the admission process.

Service information +

Ask about documents, charges, house rules and how long you can stay. Confirm the address and arrival time before travelling.

↗
Counselling

Professional counselling

HUP’s published services include professional counselling. Speak to the team about the support available for your circumstances.

Service information +

Speak to HUP about counselling and referral arrangements currently offered. Historical staff profiles do not establish current appointments or availability.

↗
Employment guidance

Help finding work

HUP has helped beneficiaries look for employment. Ask the team what practical help is currently available.

Service information +

This is employment guidance, not a promise of a job placement. Contact HUP to discuss current support or potential opportunities that an employer or partner could offer.

↗
Referral support

Specialist rehabilitation referrals

HUP has referred beneficiaries to rehabilitation centres when specialist help with substance use is needed.

Service information +

HUP is not presented here as an inpatient rehabilitation provider. Ask the team about the appropriate current referral process and available specialist services.

↗
Daily meals

Meals for shelter clients

Breakfast is served from 06:00 to 07:00, lunch from 12:00 to 13:00, and supper from 19:00 to 20:00.

Meal arrangements +

The timetable applies to HUP clients. Meals are supervised and served during the scheduled times, with one meal per client per serving. Discuss work or job-seeking arrangements with a supervisor or social worker.

↗

Ask about a place at the shelter

If you need somewhere to stay, start with the shelter enquiry page. You will find the phone numbers and the questions to ask before travelling.
